title: Prosecutor Sues Justice Dept. Over Dismissal After Right-Wing Influencer’s Claim
summary: Will Rosenzweig joins a growing list of former prosecutors and federal agents who have gone to court to contest the purge of law enforcement deemed disloyal.
body_markdown: Will Rosenzweig joins a growing list of former prosecutors and federal agents who have gone to court to contest the purge of law enforcement deemed disloyal.
